messages:
michelle (PM): Quick thread to finalize DP commitment slabs, telemetry consent wording, and partner incentives. Want this tidy before we push invites tomorrow. Thoughts?
ron (Eng): From infra: we need explicit opt-in for verbose traces. Suggest two levels: `basic telemetry` (latency, error codes, usage counts) and `diagnostic traces` (full request/response hashes masked).
anya (Research): We also need consent for storing prompt-response pairs for evals. Propose "anonymized storage for internal quality analysis" and an opt-out checkbox for publication quotes.
sam (CS): Incentives: offer $2k credit + 1 design critique session for full 6-week participation. Or alternative: early access to Dedicated pricing. Which resonates more?
lee (Security): Legal minimums: NDA + DPA. For diagnostic traces we require a hashed PII scrubber pipeline on ingest. No raw customer content stored beyond 30 days unless approved.
marie (Legal): Agree. Add explicit consent language: "We will store telemetry and anonymized transcripts for the purposes of product improvement and research." Also a line about voluntary quotes: "May we anonymize and publish excerpts?"
kev (Design): For participant experience we should show a short modal during onboarding describing telemetry levels + toggle. Mock will include 2-line explainer and examples of what we collect.
josh (Ops): Operationally, if partners enable diagnostic traces we need alerts for high-volume ingest. Recommend a quota flag in partner metadata `dp_diagnostic_quota` to avoid surprise bills.
michelle (PM): Decision points: 1) telemetry tiers (basic vs diagnostic) 2) retention policy (30d vs 90d) 3) incentives (credit vs pricing) 4) publication consent checkbox. Proposed defaults: basic telemetry enabled, diagnostic off, retention 30d, credit incentive.
ron (Eng): Implementation notes: we can gate diagnostic traces behind a role and a partner toggle. Sample curl to enable verbose traces (docs):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/partners/$PARTNER_ID/telemetry 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"level":"diagnostic","quota":1000000}'
```
(Will add to onboarding doc)
anya (Research): For evaluation, we'll ask partners to label 5 high-priority prompts at start so we have ground truth. Schedule: week0 baseline, weeks 2/4 interim checks, week6 final.
sam (CS): Screening tweak: require a named engineering contact + agreement to hold at least 4 feedback sessions across the pilot. We'll prioritize customers who can commit to product fixes being assigned to an engineer for integration.
lee (Security): Retention: 30d is fine for telemetry; for prompt-response artifacts used in evals we should keep up to 90 days but encrypt at rest and store in customer-scoped buckets. Access logged and limited.
marie (Legal): Add consent text snippet for intake form: "I agree Redwood may store anonymized transcripts and telemetry for product improvement and research. I consent to quotes anonymized for marketing/publication." Checkbox options: [Telemetry agree] [Quotes agree] [Quotes opt-out].
kev (Design): I'll make the modal and an intake form mock. Also propose a one-page partner playbook clarifying what to expect: weekly cadence, who to contact, how credits are applied.
josh (Ops): About credits: ops needs a ledger entry process. Sam, can CS mark partners as `dp_credit_approved` so finance can auto-apply?
sam (CS): Yes, we'll add that field in intake. Also will prepare a short email template that includes telemetry choices and link to modal.
michelle (PM): Success metrics for the DP: - >=70% session attendance - >=4 actionable items surfaced (triaged into backlog) - telemetry consent rate >=75% - at least 2 partners request Dedicated pricing early (signal)
ron (Eng): Minor integration ask: surface partner-level error rate dashboard for the DP cohort. We can spin up a dashboard workspace per partner.
anya (Research): One more ask: require partners to tag any example prompts they don't want used in public/testing as `sensitive`. We'll honor that tag in ingest pipeline.
lee (Security): And final: no on-prem data pipelines without signed SOW. Keep that in the intake.
product-bot: Reminder: "DP Intake Deadline" in 24 hours (2196209856).
michelle (PM): Great. Owners: kev -> modal + playbook, sam -> intake + email + finance tag, ron -> dashboard + telemetry API snippet, anya -> eval labeling plan, lee/marie -> final consent + DPA bullets. I'll publish updated intake by EOD. :rocket:
